name: talaria-desktop
description: Talaria: a customizable AI chat desktop app with tools, MCP, memory and skills

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run verify:bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac
